sources.section: Factsheet and What will you learn
sources.finding: English, full-time, three years/180 EC; American Studies is the exact specialisation within English Language and Culture. Historical, political, literary, cultural and linguistic study define the target.

sources.section: Programme, year summaries and binding study advice
sources.finding: English acquisition and interdisciplinary American analysis; positive BSA 45 of 60 EC with personal circumstances considered. Not a standalone professional licence.
Twelve compulsory 5-EC units total 60 EC. RADAr and mentoring each zero EC, recorded separately. Prospective plan is provisional, subject to change and no rights derived.

Six compulsory 5-EC units plus two 15-EC Faculty of Arts minors, one per semester. Minor menus choose three courses each; alternatives are not added as compulsory. Mentorship zero EC. Same indicative entrant sequence.

sources.section: Provisional overview 2029–2030; domestic and abroad sections; educational minor
sources.finding: First-listed domestic pathway: four compulsory 5-EC units, thesis 10 EC and genuine electives 30 EC, 60 EC total. Domestic electives normally 15 EC each semester. Abroad variant not mixed. Optional educational minor taught in Dutch with bounded secondary-school qualification; no additional thesis threshold invented.

sources.section: Occupations, further study and Lotte Scharn testimonial
sources.finding: Published graduate outcomes, selective/further study and personal content-marketing trajectory stay search-only. Tourism and Heritage is the current master name; old Tourism and Culture naming corrected in row1622. No automatic admission or UCR career qualification asserted.

routeSelection: Exact American Studies specialisation; first-listed domestic sequence, chosen independently of UCR fit. Current official pages jointly establish coherent indicative 2027–2030 180 EC. No unresolved conflict calls for OER; no claim these are formally adopted future regulations.
